editors_pick.title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI

editors_pick.summary: For the enterprise, the promise of agentic AI is much more than just a better chatbot. It is software agents that execute business tasks end-to-end across people, business workflows, data, and systems
editors_pick.summary_cn: 对企业而言，Agent的价值远超传统聊天机器人。它能够跨越人员、业务流程和数据孤岛，直接端到端自动执行核心任务，从而大幅降低企业运营成本并提升整体效率。

editors_pick.summary: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
editors_pick.summary_cn: OpenAI最新研究表明，AI正在从根本上重塑工作方式。借助ChatGPT，员工能够跨部门处理多种任务，这不仅打破了固有的岗位职责边界，更成倍提升了个人与团队的生产力。
